title: Retain each class schedule form draft in scoped browser storage

evidence: Fresh isolated Chrome 151 probe proved exact scoped three-field draft save/reload restore, center/class isolation, clean invalid-state fallbacks, invalid_schedule retention, native Form Data, and confirmed-success exact-key cleanup while an unrelated key remained.

Fresh npm run check, npm run build, npm run test (29 files / 114 tests), source/diff boundary inspection, and git diff --check passed; no backend, secret/session, dependency, server-persistence, validation, or authorization change was observed.

evidence_required: FT-002-AC-008 / REQ-004 RED: a populated schedule draft is lost on current same-form reload/return; GREEN: the exact center/class key restores only valid whitelisted dates/weekdays, other center/class and missing/malformed entries remain clean, an expected rejected submission retains the draft, and confirmed schedule_created clears only that key; decisive comparison: real-browser form values, submitted Form Data, localStorage before/after, and SSR-safe render/build; artifact: .tasks/TASK-031-T2-FT-002-W15/ and .protocols/TASK-031-T2-FT-002-W15/.
purpose: Prevent an Admin from losing an unfinished recurring-schedule form while keeping the draft disposable, class-scoped, browser-only, and outside server authority.
success_outcome: The same center/class schedule form restores its valid unfinished start date, end date, and weekday numbers after reload or return, retains them after a rejected submission, and clears only its matching draft after successful schedule creation.
anti_goals: Do not change the server schedule payload, validation, persistence, authorization, or recurring-lesson behavior.
Do not store passwords, sessions, authentication/invitation values, account/role data, arbitrary fields, or other secrets.
Do not add a dependency, server store, cookie, migration, sync mechanism, or cross-center/class restore.
Do not modify or reinterpret the completed TASK-026 card, protocol, or evidence, and do not claim a confirmed checkbox UI bug.

stop_conditions: Stop if successful matching-key cleanup cannot be observed through the existing browser form result without changing server validation, persistence, authorization, or the accepted schedule command.
Stop if implementation would access localStorage during SSR/module evaluation or would retain any field beyond the accepted whitelist.

constraints: Use the exact key study-calendar:schedule-draft:${centerId}:${classId} and exact JSON whitelist {startDate,endDate,weekdays}; stored dates are canonical ISO YYYY-MM-DD and weekdays are unique integers 0..6.
Read/write localStorage only in browser lifecycle/event code and fall back to clean defaults without throwing when storage is missing, unavailable, or malformed.
Retain the matching draft after failed validation and clear only after a confirmed successful schedule_created result while preserving the existing native form payload and server rules.
invariants: A draft never restores across centerId or classId scope.
Browser draft storage contains no password, session, authentication/invitation value, arbitrary form field, or other secret.
Missing or malformed draft state is observationally equivalent to a clean default form and cannot break SSR.
Existing empty-weekday rejection remains expected server behavior.
verification_targets: FT-002-AC-008 / REQ-004 real-browser RED/GREEN: in isolated protected state populate one class form, capture current reload loss as RED, then prove GREEN restores the same form after reload/return while another class and another center stay clean.

FT-002-AC-008 malformed/failure path: inject missing, invalid JSON, wrong-shape, invalid-date, and out-of-range-weekday values and observe clean defaults without render failure; submit dates with no weekdays, observe the expected 400 invalid_schedule and absent weekdays Form Data, then prove the accepted matching draft remains.

FT-002-AC-008 success path: submit valid ISO dates and selected weekday numbers, observe those exact Form Data values plus schedule_created, then prove only the matching localStorage key is absent and a later reload is clean.

Canonical transport boundary: source inspection plus npm run check/build/test prove no localStorage access during SSR/module evaluation, no new dependency, and no server validation/persistence/authorization change.
